import java.util.Date;
class Probe {
    interface Projection { int apply(int a, int b, int c); }
    static void use(Projection function) { function.apply(0, 0, 0); }
    static Object makeValue() { return new Object(); }
    int hidden;
    Date old;
    int sample() {
        int hidden = 1;
        Object unused = makeValue();
        hidden = 2;
        use((a, b, c) -> a);
        return hidden;
    }
}
